name: v8-transfer
note: V8 stage 2: does learning many families transfer to families never trained? Stage 1 (v8-replay) showed that replay from round 54's own mix trades forgetting against learning at a fixed budget (dev 15/21/25 of 44 at 24/54/77% replay; trained programs 35/32/28 of 36) and that a narrow curriculum (12 families) gives no cross-family transfer (neighbours 1-4/38, round 54 4/38). T50 trains the balanced split ycode/lm/v8_transfer_split.json (144 behaviours of 123 families, levels 65/47/32; 48 families held out whole) with 4 write examples per name (~7.7 per behaviour), replay at 50% of tokens, from round 54 at lr 1e-4 for 56 steps (~one epoch, ~7.5 exposures per behaviour, the exposure level at which C75 still wrote 28/36 of its programs). Everything else as stage 1.
decision: Development tasks only. Transfer = t_families (66 programs of the 48 held-out families, no skeleton shared with a trained program) and the neighbour set, against round 54 and L2 on the same sets; t_trained and t_within (45 held-back variants of trained families) measure learning and within-family generalization, which are not evidence of cross-family transfer. A cross-family gain would need a matched-budget narrow control and a second seed before any claim.
